Politics · India

Parliamentary clashes over Rahul Gandhi's statements and temple protests

Opposition MPs protested outside Parliament, chanting slogans against Prime Minister Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah. Inside, Rahul Gandhi's statements regarding Amit Shah and the Ram Mandir led to disruptions and demands for his apology. The Lok Sabha passed the Anti-Paper Leak Bill. Separately, a wife of an accused in an unauthorized construction case related to the Ram temple was given a week to explain the situation.
